evals.prompt: Scaffold a new FastAPI backend project. The project is called Contoso Reporting.
evals.expected_output: A complete FastAPI project scaffolded under src/contoso-reporting-api/ with health checks, a versioned /api/v1 router, security-headers/CSP middleware, ProblemDetails error handling, pydantic-settings config, and an HTTPS-first dev server. No authentication.
assertions: FastAPI chosen as the framework
Explicit project name Contoso Reporting normalized to Python project slug contoso-reporting
Project files created under src/contoso-reporting-api/ (default -api suffix when none specified)
pyproject.toml [project].name set to contoso-reporting-api
Import package remains app unless explicitly renamed
app/main.py create_app adds SecurityHeadersMiddleware, ProblemDetails handlers, health router, and the versioned /api/v1 router
app/health.py maps /health, /health/ready, /health/live (anonymous)
app/api/v1.py exposes an APIRouter with prefix /api/v1
app/security_headers.py adds CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options (DENY), X-Content-Type-Options, X-XSS-Protection, X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies
app/problem_details.py returns application/problem+json for errors
pyproject.toml depends on fastapi, uvicorn, pydantic, pydantic-settings (dev: pytest, httpx, ruff, mypy)
No authentication: no authlib, msal, pyjwt, session middleware, or login endpoints
No Veracity packages or Veracity-specific config referenced

app/settings.py CSP is a locked-down 'self'-only policy (base-uri 'none', style-src 'self' with no 'unsafe-inline') mirroring the .NET/Node baseline, with no external hostnames and stricter framing (frame-ancestors 'none')
HTTPS-first dev server (app/dev_server.py, web-dev script) reads HTTPS cert/key from settings

evals.prompt: Create a baseline Python web API skeleton called PaymentsGateway with health checks and a versioned API group.
evals.expected_output: A FastAPI project at src/paymentsgateway-api/ with the standard baseline (health checks, versioned /api/v1 group, security headers, ProblemDetails) and no auth.
assertions: Project files created under src/paymentsgateway-api/
app/health.py maps /health, /health/ready, /health/live
Versioned APIRouter with prefix /api/v1 created without any auth dependency
app/security_headers.py created and added to the app in app/main.py
No authentication or Veracity packages referenced
pyproject.toml targets requires-python >=3.10 with a hatchling build backend

evals.prompt: I have an existing FastAPI app under src/acme-orders-api/. Add the standard baseline (health checks, versioned /api/v1 group, CSP/security headers, ProblemDetails) without touching my existing endpoints.
evals.expected_output: Baseline capabilities integrated into the existing project: dependencies added only if missing, middleware and config merged, existing endpoints preserved. No authentication added.
assertions: Integration mode used (existing app/main.py not wholesale replaced)
app/security_headers.py and app/problem_details.py added
Health endpoints and a versioned /api/v1 router added where missing
Security-headers middleware and ProblemDetails handlers wired into the existing app factory
Only missing dependencies added (fastapi already present, not re-added)
No authentication, JWT, or Veracity auth packages added
Existing endpoints preserved and left in their original location
Existing .env / launch configuration not overwritten

evals.prompt: Scaffold a new FastAPI backend called Telemetry. Use HTTPS port 7200 for local development.
evals.expected_output: A FastAPI project at src/telemetry-api/ whose dev server / .env use HTTPS port 7200 and the standard baseline.
assertions: Project files created under src/telemetry-api/
.env APP_PORT set to 7200 and used by app/dev_server.py
Standard baseline present (health checks, versioned group, security headers, ProblemDetails)
No authentication added
